blocks.text: Sales strategies persuade customers to buy: discounts, promotions and excellent customer service. During Ramadan many grocery stores in Pakistan offer special deals, encouraging bulk buying, and many businesses increase advertising during Ramadan and Eid, when people shop more (Did You Know).

blocks.explanation: Discounts, limited-time promotions and excellent customer service.

items: Sales strategies: discounts, promotions, service; timed to festive seasons.
